assertions.name: provider switch moves the execution admission generation
assertions.detail: CommitProviderSwitch publishes the new controller generation on the session's active admission slot

assertions.name: terminated session restart is admitted from a stale slot
assertions.detail: AdmitSessionRestart returns nil instead of ErrSchedulerAdmissionConflict for a terminated session whose slot names an older generation

assertions.name: live session keeps the admission fence
assertions.detail: AdmitSessionRestart still returns ErrSchedulerAdmissionConflict for a live session whose slot names another generation

assertions.name: uncertain slot from boot recovery becomes active again
assertions.detail: a terminated session adopted as uncertain restarts and its slot ends active on the new generation
